about: Provider falsifiers: each entry breaks one check (exact text, replaced once), and every named test must then FAIL. Run with examples/agent-host/falsify.py --list capsules/model-provider/falsifiers.json. expect: caught (all named tests fail), compile_error (the mutation must not build), survives (known survivor, by design). Files are relative to examples/agent-host. command: provider (cargo test of the provider crate).

falsifiers.title: the token count wraps instead of refusing overflow
